name: **[Storra (Cloud Storage Platform)](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Personal-Google-Drive)** | Node.js, React.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, AWS S3, AWS EC2
summary: A secure cloud storage platform featuring role-based access control, secure authentication, and scalable file management.
highlights: Designed and developed a secure cloud storage API supporting file uploads, downloads, streaming previews, and metadata management.
Engineered a Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system with granular Owner, Admin, and User permissions for secure file sharing.
Implemented authentication workflows combining OTP verification with Google and GitHub OAuth for secure user access.
Strengthened application security by implementing protections against SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, and DoS attacks while validating application behavior through extensive API testing.

name: **[Video Streaming Platform](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Video-Streaming)** | AWS, Node.js, React, TypeScript, AWS Lambda, ECS Fargate, S3, CloudFront, FFmpeg, MongoDB, Docker
summary: A cloud-native video streaming platform enabling secure uploads, automated transcoding, and adaptive bitrate streaming
highlights: Built an event-driven video pipeline using AWS S3, Lambda, ECS Fargate, and FFmpeg for automatic transcoding.
Built Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) HLS streaming by generating 360p, 480p, and 720p video renditions for smooth playback across varying network conditions.
Developed a serverless backend using S3 pre-signed URLs and CloudFront signed cookies for secure uploads and video delivery.
Containerized FFmpeg with Docker and integrated MongoDB, IAM, S3, and CloudFront into a scalable media pipeline.

name: **[ShipIt (Self-Hosted CI/CD Server)](https://github.com/Raqibreyaz/Storra)** | Node.js, PM2, Telegram API, Octokit, AWS S3 + CloudFront
summary: A lightweight self-hosted CI/CD platform automating deployments through GitHub webhooks with rollback support and deployment monitoring.
highlights: Automated application deployments through GitHub webhooks, eliminating manual deployment steps and enabling repeatable software releases.
Developed a symlink-based release strategy with automated rollback triggered by health-check failures, ensuring reliable deployments.
Integrated Telegram Bot API and GitHub Commit Status API to provide real-time deployment notifications and deployment status tracking.
Implemented branch-based deployment workflows, automated frontend deployment to S3 + CloudFront, and Redis-backed deployment logs with seven-day retention for debugging and auditing.
